1
Karbal Wich Aayi Saan Veraan De Sahare.
Lut Payi Musalmana Gaye Veer Ne Marey.
Karbal Tu Sham Taein Kitay Safar Uboor Aina Ne.
Saday Sir Tu Chadraan Laiyaan Pathar V Ne Marey.

2
Be Kafan Bhirawaan Nu Ainj Chad Ke Tur Paiyaan San.
Zahra Diyaan Jaiyaan Ne Kinj Waqt Guzarey.
Sutday Ray Garam Pani Haye Shami Wich Bazaraan.
Rat Akhiyaan Choon Ronda Aye Zainab Da Pursa Daar Aye.

3
Pathraan Di Barshaan Nu Rahwaan Wich Jhaldi Rayiyaan.
Sir Zakhmi Gham Sataiyaan Wich Sham De Bazar Aye.
Shabbir Haan Main Tera Maqroz Khuda Aye Aakhay.
 Ajmal Deen-e-Khuda Layi Jinnay Bichrey Ne Warey.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas.

The verse grammar supports Punjabi, so I updated the language metadata and removed the missing-source tag. I read the ambiguous final-verse word `bichrey` as `بچڑے` (“children”).
